observations: Photo 0 shows a black Xbox console with visible scratches and scuffs on the front panel. The Xbox logo is visible on the lower left.
Photo 1 shows the front of the console from a top-down angle, with the same scratches and scuffs. The top left corner has the Xbox logo.
Photo 2 shows the back of the console with a label that includes 'XBOX ONE CONSOLE', 'MODEL: 12000543', and other specifications. The label is slightly worn and has some smudges.
All photos have a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI ODIKA UZOR'.

claims.claim: Fairly used Xbox One in very good condition
claims.evidence: Photos show visible scratches and scuffs, but no internal or functional test is shown. The condition is subjective and not fully verifiable from photos alone.
No screen or interface is shown to verify installed games. The console's internal storage and game library cannot be seen or confirmed remotely.
No controllers or power pack are visible in any photo. The seller states they are needed, but no proof is provided.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal damage
risks.proof: Video of the console powering on, showing the Xbox dashboard, and running a game.

risks.risk: Games may not be installed or may be corrupted
risks.proof: Screenshot of the Xbox dashboard showing the 5 games installed.

risks.risk: Controllers and power pack may be missing or damaged
risks.proof: Photos of the controllers and power pack, showing they are present and functional.

risks.risk: Console may have hardware issues (e.g., disc drive, HDMI, power supply)
risks.proof: Video showing the console connecting to a TV, reading a disc, and playing a game.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and running a game.
Screenshot of the Xbox dashboard showing the 5 games installed.
Photos of the controllers and power pack.
Video showing the console connecting to a TV and reading a disc.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
